mechanism_of_action: Selective peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor alpha modulator (SPPARMalpha).
primary_endpoint: Percentage change in MRI-PDFF from baseline to week 24.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint: −5.3% with pemafibrate vs −4.2% with placebo (treatment difference −1.0%, P=0.85). MRE-based liver stiffness decreased versus placebo at week 48 (difference −5.7%, P=0.036) and week 72 (−6.2%, P=0.024); ALT and LDL-C also decreased significantly.
safety_signal: Adverse events were comparable between groups; therapy was well tolerated.
